title: Pax Silica Summit (US State Dept, Office of the Spokesperson)
notes: Primary/official US government source for the Pax Silica initiative and inaugural summit. Cited at draft.md:266 for the Pax Silica economic-investment row ($250M seed / $4T target). Issues: The $250M Pax Silica Fund and $4T target are NOT stated in this Dec 11, 2025 State Dept page; those dollar figures trace to source 130 (Tom's Hardware / NYT, Mar 24, 2026).
claims: Pax Silica is a US-led strategic initiative for a secure silicon supply chain (minerals, energy, manufacturing, semiconductors, AI infrastructure, logistics)
Inaugural Pax Silica Summit convened Dec 12, 2025 by Under Secretary Jacob Helberg
8 participating countries: Japan, Republic of Korea, Singapore, Netherlands, UK, Israel, UAE, Australia
Guest contributions from Taiwan, EU, Canada, OECD
Named participants include Sony, Hitachi, Fujitsu, Samsung, SK Hynix, Temasek, DeepMind, MGX, Rio Tinto, ASML
Deliverables: joint projects on critical minerals, semiconductor design/fab/packaging, logistics, compute, energy grids; new joint ventures
